definitions.explanation: The point on a device where a wire or plug connects — a battery post, a screw terminal, or a socket such as an HDMI or USB port.

examples.japanese: {端子|たんし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{汚|よご}れている→汚れる：01293_yogoreru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧HDMI{端子|たんし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{三|みっ}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This television has three HDMI ports.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電池|でんち}→電池：01472_denchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{端子|たんし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧さび⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{付|つ}く→付く：01960_tsuku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流|なが}れ→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧にくく⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When rust forms on the battery terminals, the current has trouble flowing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{配線|はいせん}→配線：07862_haisen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つなぐ⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦プラス→プラス：00346_purasu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦マイナス→マイナス：00268_mainasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{端子|たんし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{間違|まちが}えていない→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Before connecting the wiring, please check that you have not mixed up the positive and negative terminals.

notes:
Formed from {端|たん} (end, edge) + {子|し} (small part). Used both for bare metal contacts on batteries and circuit boards and for the sockets on consumer electronics.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {端子|たんし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つなぐ: to connect a terminal
- ⟦プラス→プラス：00346_purasu⟧{端子|たんし} / ⟦マイナス→マイナス：00268_mainasu⟧{端子|たんし}: positive / negative terminal
- ⟦{入力|にゅうりょく}→入力：04769_nyuuryoku⟧{端子|たんし} / ⟦{出力|しゅつりょく}→出力：04771_shutsuryoku⟧{端子|たんし}: input / output port

SIMILAR WORDS:
- コネクタ: connector — usually the whole plug-and-socket assembly
- ⟦ポート→ポート：24425_pooto⟧: port — the katakana term, favored for computer sockets
- ⟦{差|さ}し{込|こ}み{口|ぐち}→差し込み口：30229_sashikomiguchi⟧: socket, outlet — everyday word for where a plug goes in
